$comment: English texts of data/texts.json (src/engine/overlay.js): the sentences of fights, finds, level-ups and reports, the phone notifications and the confirmation e-mail. Each key keeps the Polish number of variants, as the engine picks one by index. Names come in from the data (creatures, attacks, skills, items), numbers and lists from the code; a fight's turn (ruch) is a turn. The Polish split by the character's gender (levelHealFemale) has the same English.
eliteStart: The air thickens. The local elite: {enemies}.
The forest falls silent. The local elite: {enemies}.
championStart: The ground trembles under heavy steps. The champion of these parts: {enemies}.
The whole forest goes quiet and waits. The champion steps out: {enemies}.
toughStart: Deeper in the wilds a demanding encounter awaits: {enemies}.
The tracks lead to a stronger group: {enemies}.
crit: {actor} lands a critical hit ({attack})! {target} loses {damage} HP.
dodge: {target} steps out of the line of attack.
skillCrit: {actor} uses {skill} and lands a critical hit! {target} loses {damage} HP.
skillDodge: {actor}: {skill}! {target} steps out of the line of attack.
skillBuff: {actor}: {skill}. Until the end of the fight: armour +{armor}%, resistances +{resist}%, damage +{damage}%.
skillBuffShared: The bonus is shared across the party: each of the {count} gets a share.
skillCoat: {actor}: {skill}. Until the end of the fight each blow has a {chance}% chance of {effect}: {power}% of the blow's damage every turn for {ticks} turns.
skillShield: {actor}: {skill}. A shield made of {mana} mana will take {shield} damage.
skillEvade: {actor}: {skill}. For {hits} enemy blows, dodge rises by {dodge} percentage points, and each dodge brings a counter dealing {counter}% damage.
ambush: Ambush! {actor} appears out of nowhere and the creatures strike first.
counterCrit: {actor} lands a critical counter! {target} loses {damage} HP.
skillCoatWeaken: A poisoned target deals {weaken}% less damage.
skillShieldReflect: The shield reflects {reflect}% of the damage it absorbs.
skillEvadeBlades: Each dodge also brings a cut dealing {blades}% damage to a random enemy.
guardReflect: Meanwhile {reflect}% of the damage taken is reflected.
skillRiposte: {actor}: {skill}. Until the end of the fight dodge rises by {dodge} percentage points, and each dodge brings a counter dealing {power}% damage. Whoever it hits bleeds for {ticks} turns.
stanceFrenzy: {actor}: {skill}. For {turns} turns damage +{damage}% and healing for {lifesteal}% of the damage dealt, but damage taken +{taken}%.
stanceProvoke: {actor}: {skill}. For {turns} turns the enemies strike only this character, who reflects {reflect}% of the damage taken.
stanceCloud: {actor}: {skill}. For {turns} turns a storm cloud hangs over the enemies.
stancePet: {actor}: {skill}. For {turns} turns a falcon attacks the enemies.
stanceRegen: {actor}: {skill}. For {turns} turns the whole party recovers {heal}% of max HP each turn.
reflect: {actor} reflects part of the blow. {target} loses {damage} HP.
lifesteal: {actor} heals from the wound dealt: +{amount} HP.
renewalHot: For the next {turns} turns everyone recovers {hot}% of max HP each turn.
renewalHotMany: For the next {turns} turns everyone recovers {hot}% of max HP each turn.
summonTaken: {summon} takes the blow ({attack}) and loses {damage} HP.
summonBurst: {summon} bursts and splatters the enemies with venom.
doomed: {actor}: {skill}. After {turns} turns {target} will take {echo}% of the damage taken in that time once again.
vanished: {target} vanishes into the shadows, and the blow meets empty air.
blocked: {target} stops the blow with a shield.
skillShieldParty: {actor}: {skill}. Everyone in the party gets a shield of {percent}% of their max HP.
skillShieldSlow: Whoever strikes it slows down by {slow}%.
skillHarmony: {actor}: {skill}. Until the end of the fight each element used in spells makes the next ones {bonus}% stronger.
summonRisen: {target} rises as a skeleton ({hp} HP) and now fights against its own.

stanceRoar: {actor}: {skill}! For {turns} turns the enemies deal {weaken}% less damage, and the character {damage}% more.
stanceWall: {actor}: {skill}. For {turns} turns the whole party has {wall}% more armour.
stanceOrb: {actor}: {skill}. For {turns} turns a ball of lightning strikes the enemies.
stanceAura: {actor}: {skill}. For {turns} turns the whole party recovers {heal}% of max HP each turn.
stancePyre: {actor}: {skill}. For {turns} turns holy fire burns beneath the enemies.
stanceChoir: {actor}: {skill}. For {turns} turns the whole party recovers {heal}% of max HP each turn and deals {chorus}% more damage.
stanceVanish: {actor}: {skill}. The character vanishes into the shadows, beyond the enemies' reach; the next blow will be critical and {power}% stronger.
stanceDouble: {actor}: {skill}. For {turns} turns a shadow repeats every blow, dealing {power}% damage.
skillCostActive: Cost: {mana} mana, at most once every {cooldown} turns.
skillCostStart: Cost: {mana} mana, at the start of the fight.

classWaitsEvolution: {className}: the class waits at level {level}, on the threshold of evolution. It will grow further once you choose an evolution in the Evolution tab. The class XP gained is not lost.
